name: How do I choose the right contractor for my tub-to-shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful tub-to-shower conversion. Look for a contractor with extensive experience in bathroom remodeling, specifically conversions, and request to see examples of their past work. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are reputable and protected. Read customer reviews and testimonials to gauge their reliability and quality of service. A good contractor will also provide a detailed, transparent quote, communicate clearly, and offer a warranty on their work. Don't hesitate to ask questions and seek multiple bids before making a decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in bathroom conversions, verify their licensing and insurance, check references, review their portfolio, and ensure clear communication and transparent pricing.
